index.embed_query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

chunk_config.token_limit: min(target, model_max_seq_length); includes synopsis and special tokens
chunk_config.overlap_policy: configured fraction of previous narrative window tokens; synopsis repeated separately

tokenization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric; sklearn English stoplist; no stemming
recommendation: Recommend **lexical-bm25-ref** as the lexical leg on the primary metric. Its hybrid **hybrid-bm25-ref** changes Category P@10 versus dense by **-0.0500** (does not beat dense). Adoption is a separate decision; BM25 production integration is not implemented. BM25 improves lexical Category P@10 over OR by +0.1393, but the measured fusion does not justify replacing dense alone. Defer a pg_search integration until a production lexical/fusion change is justified.
